1075-the-strength-of-the-strong.creator: Jack London
1075-the-strength-of-the-strong.description: A book by Jack London. s yawned the black mouth of a cave, out of which, from time to time, blew draughty gusts of wind. Immediately in front of them blazed a fire. At one side, partly devoured, lay the carcass of a bear, with about it, at a respectable distance, several large dogs, shaggy and wolf-like. Beside each man lay his bow and arrows and a huge club.

arxiv-2205-05690.title: Wide twin binaries are extremely eccentric: evidence of twin binary formation in circumbinary disks
arxiv-2205-05690.creator: Hsiang-Chih Hwang, Kareem El-Badry, Hans-Walter Rix, Chris Hamilton, Yuan-Sen Ting, Nadia L. Zakamska
arxiv-2205-05690.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hsiang-Chih Hwang, Kareem El-Badry, Hans-Walter Rix, Chris Hamilton, Yuan-Sen Ting, Nadia L. Zakamska. The Gaia mission recently revealed an excess population of equal-mass “twin” wide binaries, with mass ratio q ≳ 0.95 q\gtrsim 0.95 , extending to separations of at least 1000 AU.

arxiv-2208-09941.title: Why So Inflammatory? Explainability in Automatic Detection of Inflammatory Social Media Users
arxiv-2208-09941.creator: Cuong Nguyen, Daniel Nkemelu, Ankit Mehta & Michael Best
arxiv-2208-09941.description: Abstract Hate speech and misinformation, spread over social networking services (SNS) such as Facebook and Twitter, have inflamed ethnic and political violence in countries across the globe. We argue that there is limited research on this problem within the context of the Global South and present an approach for tackling them.

arxiv-2403-16584.title: Can Large Language Models (or Humans) Disentangle Text?
arxiv-2403-16584.creator: Nicolas Audinet de Pieuchon Adel Daoud Connor T. Jerzak, Moa Johansson Richard Johansson
arxiv-2403-16584.description: Abstract We investigate the potential of large language models (LLMs) to disentangle text variables—to remove the textual traces of an undesired forbidden variable in a task sometimes known as text distillation and closely related to the fairness in AI and causal inference literature.

arxiv-2407-10173.title: StatuScale: Status-aware and Elastic Scaling Strategy for Microservice Applications
arxiv-2407-10173.creator: Linfeng Wen, Minxian Xu, Sukhpal Singh Gill, Muhammad Hafizhuddin Hilman, Satish Narayana Srirama, Kejiang Ye, Chengzhong Xu
arxiv-2407-10173.description: Abstract . Microservice architecture has transformed traditional monolithic applications into lightweight components. Scaling these lightweight microservices is more efficient than scaling servers. However, scaling microservices still faces the challenges resulted from the unexpected spikes or bursts of requests, which are difficult to detect and can degrade performance instantaneously.

pmc-10693256.title: Serotonergic Medication Error: A Case Report of Serotonin Syndrome
pmc-10693256.creator: Anh Thu N Nguyen, Riley G Fisher, Michael J Valentine, Ankur Kayastha, Hanh M Pham, Alexander T Phu, Saif A Meimon, Takara R Newsome-Cuby, Conor A Parry, Carol E Kirila
pmc-10693256.description: Serotonin syndrome (SS) describes a life-threatening clinical condition that can develop within hours or days after taking serotonergic medication(s). Medication adverse reactions, overdose, or drug interactions can cause this syndrome. Patients often present with symptoms of hyperthermia, muscle rigidity, hyperreflexia, and clonus. Symptoms range broadly in severity, often influenced by polypharmacy and age.
